name: @deterministic-code/migraters
description: Migrate executables for deterministic-code (typescript, rust, csharp).

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p orchestrator/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --prefix typescript
scripts.test: npm run test:orchestrator && npm run test --prefix typescript && npm run test:rust && npm run test:csharp
scripts.test:rust: node orchestrator/attach-sqlite.js rust-core && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=rust/target cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --lib --ignore-filename-regex 'coverage\.rs' --fail-under-lines 100 --fail-under-regions 100 && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=rust/target cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path rust/api/Cargo.toml --lib --fail-under-lines 100 --fail-under-regions 100
scripts.integration: npm run prepare && npm run integration --prefix typescript && npm run integration:rust && npm run integration:csharp
scripts.integration:rust: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=rust/target cargo test --manifest-path rust/providers/postgres/Cargo.toml --lib && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=rust/target cargo test --manifest-path rust/providers/mysql/Cargo.toml --lib && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=rust/target cargo test --manifest-path rust/providers/sqlserver/Cargo.toml --lib && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=rust/target cargo test --manifest-path rust/providers/oracle/Cargo.toml --lib && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=rust/target cargo test --manifest-path rust/providers/sqlite/Cargo.toml --lib
